title: Stocktakes
createDescription: Pick where to count. The expected quantities are recorded as of now.
emptyDescription: Start one to count the shelves and correct the stock levels.
scanPlaceholder: Scan a barcode, or type a name or SKU
scanHint: Each scan of a piece item adds one. For weighed items, enter the quantity.
scanFailed: That scan could not be recorded.
noLinesDescription: No stock-tracked items are in scope. Scan an item to add it.
varianceNote: Variance is measured against the stock on hand when each item was counted, so sales and receipts made after counting are kept.
finalizeConfirm: Stock will be corrected for the {count} counted items. The stocktake is then locked and can't be changed.
finalizeConfirmAll: Stock will be corrected for all {count} items; the {uncounted} not counted are set to zero. The stocktake is then locked and can't be changed.
countAll: Treat items not counted as zero
countAllHelp: {count} items have not been counted. Leave this off to keep their stock unchanged.
cancelConfirm: Cancel this stocktake? Counts entered so far are discarded and stock is not changed.
lockedNote: This stocktake is closed and can't be changed.
notFoundDescription: It may have been removed, or it is at a location you can't access.
loadError: The stocktake could not be loaded.
